J-64.name: Stance freshness — never a frozen green over a dead tape
J-64.note: CONFIRMED FAILING by the iter-21 evaluator's live REST probe: after POST /watch/SIM-BUYER/pause, /summary reads stream_status=paused while /research/thesis/active still serves feed_live='status live' PASS, tape_lag_ok PASS, stance conditions_met — a frozen green over a paused tape. Root cause located: monitor.py advances the checklist ONLY in on_event and builds it from _last_snapshot; on_status (pause/stale) neither refreshes the snapshot nor re-advances the evaluator (capability 20 warns status flips do not pass through events). The pure evaluator logic IS correct (paused→no_fresh_tape unit-proven, incl. from a previously-green met); the WIRING is not. closed/failed are honest by removal (thesis expires/detaches). Iter-22 must fix the wiring with a feeder-level integration test (pause → projection no_fresh_tape) plus the visible delivery_lag_seconds readout and the paused/closed browser legs; stale leg per J-15's gated pattern.
